name: San Martín del Tesorillo (Spain)
description: White field with an orange bend fimbriated blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of San Martín del Tesorillo (an orange tree on white above waves, beneath a roof).
history: Municipal flag of San Martín del Tesorillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged blue from the upper hoist to the lower fly
